name: Ferrari
blurb: The only team to have raced in every season since the championship began in 1950.

name: Mercedes
blurb: Works Mercedes returned in 2010 by buying Brawn GP, and went on to win eight constructors' titles in a row.

name: Red Bull
blurb: Born when Red Bull bought Jaguar Racing at the end of 2004. Builds its own power unit with Ford from 2026.

name: McLaren
blurb: Founded by New Zealander Bruce McLaren and the second oldest team on the grid.

name: Aston Martin
blurb: The Jordan team of 1991 became Midland and Spyker and Force India and Racing Point before taking the Aston Martin name in 2021.

name: Alpine
blurb: The Enstone factory has raced as Toleman and Benetton and Renault and Lotus before becoming Alpine in 2021. A customer Mercedes engine from 2026.

name: Williams
blurb: Frank Williams' team won nine constructors' titles between 1980 and 1997 and is now owned by Dorilton Capital.

name: Racing Bulls
full_name: Visa Cash App Racing Bulls F1 Team
blurb: The old Minardi team became Toro Rosso in 2006 and then AlphaTauri and now Racing Bulls. Red Bull's second team.

name: Haas
blurb: The first American team since 1986. Buys as many parts from Ferrari as the rules allow and builds its cars at Dallara.

name: Audi
blurb: Peter Sauber's team entered F1 in 1993, raced as BMW Sauber and Alfa Romeo, and became the Audi works team in 2026. Power units are built at Neuburg an der Donau in Germany.

name: Cadillac
blurb: The eleventh team on the grid and General Motors' entry into F1. Runs from Silverstone while its Indiana base is built and uses Ferrari power units until its own is ready.

name: Manor
blurb: The old Virgin and Marussia team. It ran out of money and left the grid after the 2016 season.
